system.description: Your character cannot be blood bound by anyone who shares his mortal bloodline. If you were born into the Giovanni family, you cannot be bound by anyone else born a Giovanni, though you can still be bound by a Pisanob of the clan or by Kindred of any other clan. Similarly, a Dunsirn with this Merit could not be bound by others born into the mortal Dunsirn family, but could be bound by a Milliner of the Giovanni clan. Giovanni who are known to manifest this trait are viewed with suspicion by the family, who tend to associate it with rebellious neonates resistant to discipline.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
